articles.title: Standard Chartered brings spot crypto trading to Dubai FX platform
articles.snippet: The bank is now offering institutional crypto spot trading in the region, bringing BTC and ETH onto the same eFX rails that institutions use to trade dollars and euros.

articles.title: Crypto for Advisors: Why crypto earnings reports can be misleading
A memecoin making app becomes crypto’s top fee generators as Robinhood Chain activity explodes
articles.snippet: Users paid nearly $6 million in a day to create and trade tokens through Pons, more than they paid to use Pump or Hyperliquid, and even more than they paid to use Robinhood Chain itself.

articles.title: Bitget in talks with Wall Street giants including BlackRock to fuel Asian distribution
articles.snippet: Gracy Chen highlighted the world's largest asset manager as one example of such a firm seeking to expand distribution of their tokenized ETFs in the region.

articles.title: SoFi, Kraken tie up as crypto and banking push into each other's turf
articles.snippet: Kraken is joining SoFi's settlement network and list SoFiUSD as the companies link traditional banking with crypto markets.
